GENERATE BURST MW3D-E — Run C-9 pipeline review (Matt R-C9-60): PAINT-OVER of one walk cycle of an AI-generated 3D knight, on one sheet. task_id "MW3D-E".

IMAGE 1 is a SPRITE SHEET: 12 animation frames of ONE walk cycle of a knight walking to the viewer's RIGHT (east), in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), each frame centred in its own cell of a 4x3 grid, on flat pure #00ff00. The frames are renders of a 3D model: their POSES, OUTLINES, POSITIONS and SIZES are correct, but their surface is flat, pale and plastic. The knight carries NO weapon in these frames: both hands are EMPTY (the weapon is a separate layer added later).
IMAGE 2 is the approved painting of this same knight facing the same way: his exact helm and visor, gorget, plate armour, blue tabard with gold crosses and diagonal gold-and-blue bands and red lining, and the painter's hand (dark ink line, hatching, transparent washes). IMAGE 3 is the same knight with the tabard removed (the waist lames and mail skirt under it).
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536x1024 sheet in which EVERY one of the 12 figures is repainted as the knight of IMAGE 2, in EXACTLY that frame's pose, outline, position and size: same place in its cell, same leg and arm angles, feet on the same spot. Paint all 12 in ONE consistent hand, so that the armour, the tabard heraldry, the helm and the colours are IDENTICAL from frame to frame (this is an animation: any change between frames will flicker). Do NOT add a weapon: both hands stay empty, as in IMAGE 1. Where the tabard parts, show the mail of IMAGE 3.
Keep the background flat pure #00ff00, the 4x3 grid exactly as laid out, no frame added, removed, merged or reordered, no cell borders, no text, no ground shadows.
STYLE: the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY IMAGE 2: copy its hand; do not restyle.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if a frame's pose or position changed, a frame is missing or duplicated, the knight differs between frames, a weapon was added, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/MW3D-E_a.png and out/MW3D-E_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "MW3D-E"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the sprite sheet to EDIT (12 walk frames of the AI-generated 3D knight; poses correct, surface flat)
IMAGE 2 — the approved painting of this knight facing east (look, armour, heraldry, hand)
IMAGE 3 — the same knight with the tabard removed (the armour and mail under it)
